method: Compared every complete script, level, title and all 128 canonical questions/options/answers with the prior reviewed authoring payload. Only the known English presentation projection is removed for equivalence. The 32 translated A1 prompts were also checked against complete scripts by Codex. The sixteen current US files have separate exact generation and real decode evidence.
reviewer: Codex source/code review; not a human examiner, independent blind solve or difficulty calibration
runtimeBoundary: The source policy still accepts only explicitly registered current hashes and the original ID/level/kind/review constraints. Prior hashes and authoringContentHash are not runtime fallbacks. Backend content/transcript/MP3 integrity checks remain separate.

audio.scope: Recorded US synthetic voice identities, exact script/MP3/configuration hashes and actual decode; not independent auditory or phoneme certification.
